MAINTENANCE GUIDE

Built to keep evolving.

Four purpose-built pages in one static site. No build dependencies, no database and no connection to local projects.

What each template does

Fieldnotes：An original launch template. The workflow is a local example and does not call AI.

Pulse：Shows public repository metrics with snapshot and refresh timestamps. No historical growth data; this is not GitHub Trending.

Common Ground：Personal tasks are stored in this browser with import and export. No GitHub Issues sync or shared workspace.

Open Atlas：A directory of official links with browser-local favorites and custom entries. Not a public submission platform.

The GitHub maintenance workflow

Keep source in your chosen GitHub repository and review changes with branches, pull requests and checks. After merging, sync the exact code through Codex Sites, save a version and deploy. A GitHub push and a Sites deployment are separate steps.

GitHub Actions checks are included, but no GitHub repository or automatic deployment is connected yet. Short-lived Sites credentials must not be used as permanent GitHub secrets.

From source to deployment

src/ contains pages and interactions; src/data/ contains curated resources and repository snapshots. Run npm run check、npm run build , then save and deploy with Sites.

To update the repository snapshot, run npm run refresh. This calls only the fixed list of public GitHub APIs and sends no account credentials.

Community inspiration and sources

These are original implementations. No source code or branding was copied from the following projects; they informed the use cases and information structure.

  • shadcn-admin: admin and data interfaces
  • AstroWind: product and content pages
  • ShadcnStore: launch pages and dashboards
  • OpenAI Sites: hosting and publishing

Data and privacy

This site has no registration and stores no visitor tasks or favorites on a server. Refreshing analytics calls api.github.com from your browser and may hit network or API limits. Clearing browser data removes local tasks and favorites; export important tasks first.
